title.value: Scenario 2 - EU-PS level 2: Narrative summaries only

description.value: The serving system provides an EU-PS for its level 2 test patient, in which every mandatory section has a narrative summary and no structured entries. The patient is selected by the token entered at test setup. Implementation Guide: https://build.fhir.org/ig/hl7-eu/eps/
